title: Late-Game TSS [Tom's Simple Storage]
description: Tweaks recipes for Tom's Simple Storage so that it requires further progression to craft stuff.
body:
# What does this do?
This datapack alters certain crafting recipes in [Tom's Simple Storage Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/toms-storage) to lock it behind certain progression. With some items needing chorus fruit or calibrated sculk sensors in order to craft.

# Why would you want this?
This datapack was created for those who want to include a storage mod in their world, but don't want it to feel overpowered or too easy to set up quickly (great for vanilla+ servers)!

With this datapack enabled, you will have more incentive to explore areas such as the deep dark or the outer end islands as you will need resources from both in order to create a complex yet convenient storage system!
